pages.title: Install, then activate
pages.text: Wear power armor or hold an Enhanced Energy Sabre or Energy Lance in your main hand. Press the configuration key, normally $(thing)0$(), and select a piece.$(br2)Each row has $(thing)Mod$(), $(thing)On$() and $(thing)Key$() controls. Click the module icon to install from your inventory or remove it. The checkbox enables it; the last control assigns hotkey group $(thing)1–4$(). Installing alone does not activate a module.

pages.title: Return or close
pages.text: Press the configuration key again from an equipment panel or the help page to return to equipment selection. Press it on the selection menu to close the panel.$(br2)Module tooltips give a short effect, compatible equipment and usage. Use this Tablet for details: $(l:ariente:equipment/modules)Armor Modules$(/l), $(l:ariente:equipment/sabres)Energy Sabres$(/l), $(l:ariente:equipment/lance)Energy Lance$(/l) and $(l:ariente:equipment/fuel)Fuel on the Move$(/l).$(br2)The panel’s question mark opens this entry when Patchouli is available. X closes the panel. Equipment panels have no pin control.

pages.title: Respect each piece’s limit
pages.text: The Energy Holder supplies one shared fuel pool, while each piece keeps its own module budget. Active modules normally have to fit within $(thing)100$() usage. An enabled Energy module raises this to $(thing)130$() and reduces that piece’s draw on the holder.$(br2)Overloaded pieces stop their powered abilities. Other equipment can keep working. Disable an ability or add Energy before heading into danger.

pages.title: Efficiency and fuel
pages.text: Carry a fueled $(l:ariente:equipment/fuel)Energy Holder$(/l). Its total stored power appears at the bottom of every equipment panel. Fuel stays in the holder when you swap gear; the old Autofeed module is no longer needed.$(br2)Each active piece draws from the same supply. At default settings, usage 50 on one piece burns a dust pair in about 30 seconds, or 40 seconds with Energy enabled. Energy improves only the piece carrying it; other pieces keep their own budgets and fuel rates.

pages.title: Set up quick toggles
pages.text: Assign modules to a hotkey group in the equipment panel. One group can toggle several modules across your worn armor and held weapon.$(br2)Groups 1 and 2 default to Numpad 7 and 8. Set the other groups in Controls.$(br2)Test fuel, activation and movement before a risky climb or fight.
